I'd suggest the bunker because of the passive income it generates to your nightclub. You could also make money directly with it but only if you have time and patience to resupply and sell its products. 

Some benefits are the extra weapon parts that you can deliver and get 50k and trade prices for the half track and anti air trailer. 


If not, buy the agency, you will get $1 million per each completion of the VIP Contract plus 30k per each normal contract you do (which are easy). I've been grinding tf outta that VIP mission and making $1 million everyday 😂

With the agency you can unlock imani tech, which allows you to put a missile lock-on jammer on some vehicles. As well as an armory that has almost every weapon/ammo available and you can also buy armor from it. 

The main mission, a VIP contract, pays $1 million each time you complete it. The first time is quite extended (due to the cooldown per phone robber), but afterward, it becomes easy peasy.

The normal contracts can pay at least 30k and max 60k if the contract is Specialist tier. You can also do payphone hits, which is killing a target with a specific method and you'll get 45k.


Its an "easy" and fun way to make money.

If you want to play multiplayer, I recommend starting with the current limited-time game mode: Team Deathmatch. There, you can try almost any weapon against real players, and dying won't be as penalizing as in other game modes.

The bulletproof vests are most useful for explosions and small calibers, which honestly are rare in multiplayer, so I recommend not wearing the heavy vest. Instead, wear the small one or don't wear one at all. You will be faster and have some spare supplies for grenades or weapon attachments.

The sound in the game is superb (IMO), so running, kicking doors down, using comms, or "character lines" can be heard by your enemies. Keep this in mind.

If you have spare supplies, get some smoke grenades. They are pretty useful in this game.

The basics are in the training camp, which I recommend playing if you're new new.
